main_loop_interval.description: The wake up frequency of the main daemon (in seconds).

host_monitor_interval.description: The data collection interval for host statistics (in seconds).

guest_monitor_interval.description: The data collection interval for guest statistics (in seconds).

guest_manager_interval.description: The wake up frequency of the guest manager (in seconds).

hypervisor_interface.description: The interface MOM using to discover active guests and collect guest memory statistics. Choices: libvirt, vdsm.

policy_engine_interval.description: The wake up frequency of the policy engine (in seconds).

controllers.description: A comma-separated list of Controller plugins to enable.

sample_history_length.description: Sets the maximum number of statistic samples to keep for the purpose of calculating moving averages.

libvirt_hypervisor_uri.description: The URI to use when connecting to this host's libvirt interface. If left blank, the system default URI is used.

plot_dir.description: Set this to an existing, writable directory to enable plotting. If empty, plotting is disabled.

rpc_port.description: Activate the RPC server on the designated port (-1 to disable).

policy_file.description: At startup, load a policy from the given file. If empty, no policy is loaded.

policy_dir.description: At startup, load policies from the given directory. Only filenames matching *.policy will be considered.

guest_manager_multi_thread.description: Monitor each VM in a separate thread (true) or use a single thread for all VMs (false).

log_destination.description: Set the destination for program log messages. This can be either 'stdio' or a filename.

log_level.description: Set the logging verbosity level. Supported levels: debug, info, warn, error, critical.

host_collectors.description: A comma-separated list of Collector plugins to use for Host data collection.

guest_collectors.description: A comma-separated list of Collector plugins to use for Guest data collection.

socket_path.description: Set the base path where the host-side sockets for guest communication can be found.

socket_name_template.description: Set the socket name template. Default: %(name)s.agent.
